answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a ferrous bet on surviving 117 epochs of grading, and every ripple settlement recomputes the violet schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 117 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
